summary:
Zillow is the home-listings site at zillow.com. The blue “Z” in the tab is the icon saved-search bookmarks use, measured from the downloaded file.

Checked 12 November 2026 against zillow.com. HTML came from https://www.zillow.com/ (HTTP 403). No icon link tags were readable in the HTML. Files below came from a manifest or from a path that returned an image.

The favicon.ico URL is https://www.zillow.com/favicon.ico. The saved file favicon.ico is 4286 bytes. Directory sizes: 32×32.

The apple-touch-icon URL is https://www.zillow.com/apple-touch-icon.png, measured at 180×180 png.

Brand colour #0066ff comes from the most common non-white pixel in png-180x180-01.png, quantised to 4 bits per channel.
